description: This file implements the NetworkManager GDBus proxy class, providing network interface management, IP configuration, WiFi operations, and event handling for a Raspberry Pi 4 environment within the RDK platform.

classes.name: NetworkManagerImplementation
classes.description: Main class managing network interfaces, IP settings, WiFi operations, and event handling within the platform.

methods.name: getInitialConnectionState
methods.description: Checks current network interfaces, reports their status, and IP addresses.

methods.name: platform_logging
methods.description: Sets network manager daemon log level based on plugin log level.

methods.name: platform_init
methods.description: Initializes the network manager, sets default interface, and starts event monitoring.

methods.name: GetAvailableInterfaces
methods.description: Retrieves list of available network interfaces and their statuses.

methods.name: SetInterfaceState
methods.description: Enables or disables a specified network interface.

methods.name: GetInterfaceState
methods.description: Retrieves the enabled/disabled state of a specified interface.

methods.name: GetIPSettings
methods.description: Gets the IP address configuration of a specified interface.

methods.name: SetIPSettings
methods.description: Sets the IP address configuration for a specified interface.

methods.name: StartWiFiScan
methods.description: Initiates a WiFi scan with optional frequency and SSID filters.

methods.name: StopWiFiScan
methods.description: Stops ongoing WiFi scan.

methods.name: GetKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Retrieves list of known WiFi SSIDs.

methods.name: AddToKnownSSIDs
methods.description: Adds a WiFi SSID to the known list.

methods.name: RemoveKnownSSID
methods.description: Removes a WiFi SSID from the known list.

methods.name: WiFiConnect
methods.description: Connects to a specified WiFi network.

methods.name: WiFiDisconnect
methods.description: Disconnects from current WiFi network.

methods.name: GetConnectedSSID
methods.description: Retrieves the SSID of the currently connected WiFi network.

methods.name: GetWifiState
methods.description: Gets the current WiFi state.

methods.name: StartWPS
methods.description: Starts WPS connection process with specified method.

methods.name: StopWPS
methods.description: Stops ongoing WPS process.

methods.name: SetHostname
methods.description: Sets the DHCP hostname.
